observations: Silver laptop with a black keyboard and touchpad.
The screen is off and appears to have a significant dark smudge or burn-in across the center.
The Toshiba logo is visible on the bottom center of the screen bezel.
The laptop is sitting on a wooden desk with a piece of paper in the foreground.
The image is blurry and has a high level of digital noise.

claims.evidence: The brand logo is visible in photo 0 but the model is not readable.
The keyboard switch condition cannot be determined from a single photo.
The condition of the chassis and ports cannot be fully assessed from the photo.

claims.claim: For more information call or Whatsapp:[phone]
claims.evidence: The phone number is not visible in the photo.

risks.risk: The screen may be cracked, dead, or have a significant dead pixel issue.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the screen powered on showing the desktop or a video of it working.

risks.risk: The keyboard may have stuck keys or faulty switches.
risks.proof: A video of someone typing on the keyboard while the laptop is running.

risks.risk: The laptop may not power on or have a faulty fan.
risks.proof: A video of the laptop booting up and the fan running.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the screen powered on to check for cracks or dead pixels.
Photo of the keyboard while the laptop is running to check for stickiness.
Video of the laptop booting up and the fan running.
Photo of the ports and the underside of the chassis.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
